_about: Curated list of CA organisations / certificates distrusted by major root programs. Matching is on chain certificates' subject/issuer names. Sources: public root-program announcements (Chrome Root Program, Mozilla CA Program / CCADB, Apple). Verify and extend before production use.

entries.reason: eMudhra intermediate CA keys found to be trivially weak (Oct 2026). Chrome blocked the affected TLS intermediates and scheduled removal of the emSign ECC Root CA - G3; Mozilla and Apple also blocked affected certificates. eMudhra announced its exit from the global TLS certificate business.
entries.source: Public reporting on the October 2026 eMudhra CA incident (Chrome/Mozilla/Apple actions)

entries.reason: Chrome distrusts Entrust-issued TLS certificates issued after 11 Nov 2024 after a pattern of compliance failures.
